description.value:
You send your voice through the Force to a single creature you can see within range. Only that creature hears the message, and it may answer in a whisper only you can perceive.

The message can pass through solid barriers if you know your target is beyond them and are familiar with it — though an enhanced silence effect, a foot of stone, an inch of common metal, a thin sheet of lead, or three feet of wood blocks it. It need not travel in a straight line.

system.source: PHB Ch.14 Casting — Universal Powers, At-Will
